name: FFS_ROUTE_HISTORY
description: Contains a route modification history to be shown on a corresponding screen.

columns.name: ROUTE_ID
columns.description: Route history reference to route identifier.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: ID of a parent action_log record.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Route history time of the action in GMT format.

columns.name: OPERATION_TIME
columns.description: Time when this operation is performed by user (GMT).

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Sequential ID of transaction that defines an order of operations inside of the system.

columns.name: INTERFACE
columns.description: Interface the action is performed from.

columns.name: SCREEN_ID
columns.description: ID of the screen the action is performed from (reserved for a future use).

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: ID of the user the operation is performed by.

columns.name: USER_AGENT_ID
columns.description: Route history identifier of the user agent info (browser info etc). Reference to ffs_http_user.agent_id.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE
columns.description: Route history new values of affected fields.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ROUTE_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Contains unique identifier of the row. System generated.
